cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You offered to finish the fete banner. I copied your big SAMPLE heading to get it started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was the printer's proof. SAMPLE isn't part of the banner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, a test heading. Replace it with RAFFLE and put the draw time underneath.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can paint a time, but nobody has organized the draw.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the unfinished bit of the banner you offered to finish. Arrange the draw, then you can fill in its time.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies a proof label and invokes the earlier banner offer; A3 calls it a test, then A5 treats B4 unorganized raffle as the unfinished portion of that same offer.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 SAMPLE correction causes A3 replacement heading/time; B4 no draw organized causes A5 event organization assignment.

relationship.evidence: B4 can paint a time but cannot invent one, a practical limit.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4 missing information into responsibility rather than merely asking a new favor.

specificity.evidence: A1 banner/proof label and B4 missing raffle schedule are concrete and legible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 unfinished bit of banner is a pointed scope expansion addressed to the original volunteer.
